'''Talia Moonseeker''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Aargauun]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Moonseeker was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Va'too]] and successfully passed the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]], becoming a Knight. Four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after her promotion, Moonseeker, her former Master, and a large [[Jedi assault team/Legends|group of Jedi]] were sent on a mission to rescue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from execution on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. The rescue mission turned into the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|opening battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and although Moonseeker survived it, her former Master was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Shaken by the loss, she mourned her deceased mentor on the battlefield.

==Biography==
Talia Moonseeker was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Aargauun]] who lived during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By virtue of her [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]], Moonseeker was accepted by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. She was chosen as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Va'too]] and passed the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]]<ref name="WS" /> around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> becoming a full [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="WS" />

Four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after Moonseeker was promoted to the rank of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight, fellow Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi was captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during a mission on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]]. Both Moonseeker and her former Master were part of a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] assembled by Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to rescue the trio. However, the rescue mission turned into a [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|full-scale battle]] with the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], and while Moonseeker survived the engagement&mdash;which marked the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;Va'too was killed in action. After the Republic victory in the battle, Moonseeker returned to the [[Petranaki arena|execution arena]], where the fight began, and mourned her old Master, before ensuring that the body was carried away from the battlefield.<ref name="WS" />

==Personality and traits==
Talia Moonseeker was able to reach the rank of Jedi Knight under the tutelage of Master Va'too. She survived the Battle of Geonosis, although many other Jedi, like her former Master, were killed. After the battle, Moonseeker openly mourned at the body of her Master and afterward tried to ensure that Va'too's body was carried away by Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="WS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Moonseeker first appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Wild Space|''Wild Space'']], a tie-in novel for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. ''Wild Space'' was written by [[Karen Miller]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="WS" /> In the book, her species name, Aargauun, was misspelled as Argauun. Miller confirmed the mistake and that she was referencing the obscure species, not creating a new one.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:KMillerEmail2.png|creator=[[Karen Miller]]|date=2012-06-29}}</ref>
